card.name: The word what after share or determining
card.fires_on: The word "what" right after verbs like "share" or "determining", especially in the Merriam-Webster prompt "Please share what surprised you most". It also fires on the last digit of a year in a posting date.

modes.label: what after share

modes.example: What made you want to look up "tenor drum"? Please share<< what>> surprised you most...
